cs.t: both my kids are using my old Filco TKL keyboards with blues. Absolutely no complaints from either of them. Only issues are that the footpads are getting a little worn down, one is missing, and I think I spilled beer on one many years ago before I gave them up. I also have the Filco keycap puller. Keyboard cleaned and saved! I now use a Keychron K2 with browns. My fingers are getting too old to use blues on a regular basis.
cs.th: Diatec, known for its mechanical keyboard brand FILCO, has ceased operations

cs.t: It’s nothing to do with the manufacturer. I have 3 Filco Majestouch TKL keyboards, all with Cherry MX “silent” Red switches. They are quiet in and of themselves. The only noise from them is if I bang away at them too hard, which is generally a sign that I’m frustrated and need to go for a walk. (It’s mostly my wife or kid who point out I’m being too noisy, and they are right 99% of the time.) Sad to see Filco go. I’ll keep an eye on eBay for any bargains to keep a spare of two.
cs.th: Diatec, known for its mechanical keyboard brand FILCO, has ceased operations
